name: Dazzling Strike
body:
Your combat expertise with your chosen weapon bedazzles your foes. Their eyes go wide as your steel dances over them, causing their lifeblood to spill to the ground.

Prerequisite(s): 4th-level fighter

Benefit: When you successfully strike a foe, that foe must immediately make a DC 15 will save or be dazed until the end of your next turn. This feat affects all creatures, save undead.
